title: Radiomics and deep-learning ultrasound nomogram for indeterminate thyroid nodules
summary: A five-centre study extracted radiomics and deep-learning features from B-mode and strain elastography ultrasound to build signature scores, combined by multivariate regression into an online nomogram for indeterminate thyroid nodules. AUC was 0.907 in training, 0.885 on the independent test cohort (CI 0.821-0.932) and 0.860 in prospective validation (CI 0.762-0.929). The final model is a regression nomogram over the signature scores, and cohort sizes are not in the abstract.
ai_technology: Radiomics and deep-learning features from B-mode and strain elastography ultrasound combined in a nomogram
organization: First Affiliated Hospital of Anhui Medical University

evidence.tested: Independent external test cohort and a prospective validation cohort across five centres.
evidence.unknown: Cohort sizes, whether the model was frozen before prospective validation, and clinical benefit; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep-learning and radiomics features from two ultrasound modes were reduced to signature scores for the nomogram.
